sources.name: ArchDaily
sources.summary: OHLAB presents a house that retreats from the urban landscape to inhabit the mountain through a silent, fragmented, almost buried architecture. Rejecting protagonism, it proposes a way of living that cultivates a dialogue with the terrain and redefines the relationship between nature and domesticity.
